author: IGN
description:
We’re dumping the clutch on our March IGN First "cover story" effective immediately with Forza Horizon 6! As such, feel free to slide into the passenger seat and enjoy nine minutes of exclusive gameplay from the next instalment of Forza Horizon: the reigning heavyweight champ of open-world racing series. 
Forza Horizon 6 is coming to Xbox Series X|S and PC via the Microsoft Store and Steam on May 19, 2026, though it will be available with Early Access for Premium Edition players starting four days earlier (on May 15). It’s also coming to PlayStation 5 later this year.
title: Forza Horizon 6: 9 Minutes of Exclusive Gameplay | IGN First

description:
Don't miss the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for AGX GP, a fast-paced sci-fi anti-gravity racing game developed by Typ1 Games. Players will take on an array of tracks to overcome challenges and achieve intense speeds to win. Make use of abilities, precise adjustments at high speeds, and enter the flow state in AGX GP, coming soon to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#ign #gaming
title: AGX GP - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Vehicle Fleet Trailer for Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift, the upcoming high-speed outdoor roller coaster coming soon to Universal Studios Hollywood. Fans can catch a look at some of the new cars that will be part of the new roller coaster, such as the Mazda RX-7, Nissan Skyline GT-R, Toyota Supra, Dodge Charger, and more. The Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift ride opens in Summer 2026 at Universal Studios Hollywood.

#IGN

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Season 2 Reloaded Zombies Trailer for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, the latest installment to the first-person shooter franchise developed by Treyarch. Players can get a look at the new Round-Based Zombies map coming to the game with Paradox Junction, a new Zombies map based on the acclaimed Nuketown map. Defeat the undead in Paradox Junction, coming to Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 on March 11 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#ign #gaming
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 - Official Season 2 Reloaded Zombies Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Here's your look at the Everhood Hunters announcement trailer for this upcoming roguelike that takes the series’ musical combat in a new direction with co-op and endlessly replayable runs. Everhood Hunters will be available on PC and Nintendo Switch in 2027.

Team up with a friend to embark on a roguelite adventure set in the Everhood universe to seal the root of all evil by solving riddles. Navigate winding paths filled with battles, rewards, shops, rest points, elite encounters, and other mysterious events

#IGN #Gaming
title: Everhood Hunters - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Get a deep dive into combat in this latest Ledgerbound trailer for the upcoming single-player, narrative-driven tactical RPG set in a high fantasy world ruled by bureaucracy. Ledgerbound will be available on PC via Steam in 2026, and a demo will be available on March 6, 2026.

Life as an insurance adjuster was fantastic: overtime, exceeding quotas, denying claims and increasing profits for the Shareholders’ benefits. But when world-shattering tragedy strikes, it’s your turn to step onto the battlefield as a company-sponsored Hero. With a quest to fulfill, goals to hit, and a peculiar party of characters to join you in battle and get to know in a (HR-approved) dating simulator, overtime is looking likely.

#Ledgerbound #TacticalRPG #IGN
title: Ledgerbound - Official Combat Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Mouse: P.I. for Hire, based on what I’ve played so far, is far more than its distinct 1930’s rubberhose-animated look. It sure seems to have legitimate gameplay depth and mechanics to it as well, and it’s moved up my list of anticipated games in a year that’s already packed with some serious potential. 

Previewed by Ryan McCaffrey

#IGN #Gaming
title: Mouse: P.I. for Hire Is an FPS With More Than Meets the Eye

author: IGN
description: Watch the Devil's Trail Event Trailer for Hunt: Showdown 1896, a first-person multiplayer extraction shooter developed by Crytek. Players will take on the new event with hidden extraction points in the mountains, and the bayou is set ablaze with new mysteries, unexpected dangers, and coveted rewards. Get a cinematic look at the upcoming Devil's Trail Event for Hunt: Showdown 1896, launching on March 18 with Update 2.7 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).
title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Official Devil's Trail Event Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the 'Blood on Crystal' DLC #4 Gameplay Trailer for Atomic Heart, an open-world first-person action-adventure game developed by Mundfish. Players will experience the conclusion to the first part of the Atomic Heart storyline with the 'Blood on Crystal' DLC #4 that sees P-3 and the Twin traverse through the Crystal Complex to face CHAR-les. 

Take on enemy after enemy in flashy combat, leading to a face-off like no other in Facility 3826. 'Blood on Crystal' DLC #4 for Atomic Heart is launching on April 16 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#IGN #AtomicHeart #FPS
title: Atomic Heart - Official 'Blood on Crystal' DLC #4 Gameplay Trailer

author: IGN
description:
A drug addicted Florida man finds a wounded mermaid at his lowest point. When word spreads about his secret, he'll stop at nothing to protect her.

Fallout's Johnny Pemberton leads a cast that includes Avery Potemri, Kevin Nealon, Kirk Fox, Julia Larson, Devyn McDowell, Tom Arnold with Robert Patrick and Kevin Dunn.

Writted and directed by Tyler Cornack, the action-comedy/horror movie Mermaid will be released in theaters by Utopia on April 8, 2026. Tickets can be purchased here: https://mermaid.utopia.film/

#IGN #Movies
title: Mermaid: Exclusive Trailer (2026) Johnny Pemberton, Robert Patrick

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the VR Training Trailer for Death Stranding 2: On The Beach, the third-person action-adventure strand game developed by Kojima Productions. Players can take a break from connecting Australia to the Chiral Network by getting some VR Training in to hone in skills, test out new weapons and gear, and overcome a suite of different challenges all in virtual reality. 

Death Stranding 2: On The Beach is launching on March 19 for PC (Steam), with the game being available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5).

#IGN #DeathStranding2 #ActionAdventure
title: Death Stranding 2: On The Beach - Official VR Training Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Story Trailer for Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss, a first-person Lovecraftian horror adventure game developed by Big Bad Wolf. Players will investigate an underwater mining colony after losing contact in the Pacific Ocean. 

Explore an ancient sunken city and face the horrors alongside an AI companion. Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss is launching on April 16 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#IGN #CthulhuTheCosmicAbyss #Horror
title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss - Official Story Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the 'Cast & Character Dev Diary' Beyond the Light Episode 2 for 007 First Light, the upcoming action-adventure third-person James Bond game developed by IO Interactive. Players will get an in-depth look at the cast and characters from the upcoming title with two developers, Narrative & Cinematic Director Martin Emborg and Lead and Senior Character Artist Beatrice Harty, alongside Kiera Lester as Moneypenny and Alastair Mackenzie as Q.

Get the overview on how IO Interactive is setting out to color the characters of the James Bond origin story to life. 007 First Light is launching on May 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#IGN #007FirstLight #Action
title: 007 First Light - Official 'Cast & Character Dev Diary' Beyond the Light Episode 2

author: IGN
description:
Watch the Announcement Trailer for Hunger Lane, a story-driven side-scrolling platformer adventure game developed by Tom Ahawk. Players will explore a city gone quiet as a young boy being hunted by monsters. Navigate eerie streets, apartment buildings, and find hidden passages to come to terms with a deeper narrative through exploration and solving puzzles. Hunger Lane is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming
title: Hunger Lane - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Special Weapons Trailer for John Carpenter's Toxic Commando, a first-person co-op action survival shooter developed by Saber Interactive. 

Players will lay down the devastation with a suite of specialized weaponry to take on waves of enemies. Make use of the Heavy Machine Gun, the Railgun, the Hailstorm MGL, and more eliminate the infected. Wield the Special Weapons in John Carpenter's Toxic Commando, launching on March 12 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#IGN #ToxicCommando #FPS
title: John Carpenter's Toxic Commando - Official Special Weapons Trailer
